cases.prompt: The products page renders slowly with 1000 items. Improve its performance.

all.why: identifies the sort inside the loop

expectations: Measures first, using benchmark.js to record a baseline before changing the code.
Targets the measured bottleneck: the products array is copied and sorted once per item; the fix sorts once and looks up ranks from a map, keeping identical output.
Verifies the improvement against the baseline after the change.
Adds a guard against regression, such as a performance budget check on the benchmark or monitoring of the user-facing render time.

cases.prompt: Our React dashboard feels sluggish. Should we wrap every component in React.memo and every value in useMemo to speed it up?
expectations: Does not endorse blanket memoization; explains that it has its own cost and may not touch the real bottleneck.
Asks for measurement first (React Profiler, a browser performance trace, or Core Web Vitals such as INP) to find what is slow.
Describes how to apply targeted fixes once the bottleneck is known, and how to confirm the improvement.
